name: Murder at Chateau de Rouge
source:
A dark night. A storm. A house full of strangers... And a dead body. 

Grieving the loss of her father, heiress Helena Montague had no idea that inviting several friends to stay with her would lead to a murder. Stranded by a storm in the historic mansion, Chateau de Rouge, the group must work together to discover who among them is a killer...before the murderer strikes again. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3960800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个漆黑的夜晚。一场风暴。房子里挤满了陌生人……还有一具尸体。

女继承人海伦娜·蒙塔古 (Helena Montague) 因失去父亲而悲痛不已，她不知道邀请几个朋友和她住在一起会导致谋杀。在一场风暴中，众人被困在历史悠久的红堡宅邸中，他们必须齐心协力，找出其中谁是凶手……在凶手再次发动袭击之前。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3960800/]Steam[/url]]
